subject: Private deployment feasibility: VPC / on-prem resourcing & risk triage
messages:
From: Sara Lindgren <sara.lindgren@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: infra-team@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation: VPC or on-prem deployment for regulated workloads

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and platform teams reviewed Redwood and asked for a feasibility note: can we run a private deployment for a subset of workloads in our VPC or on-prem (air-gapped) to meet data residency and control requirements?

High-level asks:
- Support for private VPC peering / private endpoints OR an on-prem bundle we can run (air-gapped).
- Clear list of infra/resources required for a pilot (models, GPUs, network, HA).
- An initial ballpark of timeline and cost for a 3-month pilot and what sign-off steps we should expect from Redwood.

I've attached our security requirements so you can see constraints (encryption, audit logs, retention). Can your team do a short feasibility note by EOD tomorrow?

Attachments: acme-security-reqs.pdf

Sara
Sara Lindgren
Head of Cloud Platform, Acme Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation: VPC or on-prem deployment for regulated workloads

Folks — forwarding an incoming request from Acme (see attached). High priority pilot ask (security + data residency). They want a feasibility note + pilot resource estimate by tomorrow EOD if possible.

Immediate asks I want us to address in the note:
- Two recommended deployment paths (VPC-hosted private endpoint vs on-prem bundle) with tradeoffs.
- Minimal viable pilot footprint: model sizes, GPU count, storage, and network requirements.
- Timeline (engineering lead time + procurement steps).
- Any non-standard dependencies (HSM/KMS, code freeze, compliance evidence we must produce).
- Risk and mitigations (availability, rollout rollback, version pinning).

Priya, please call out compliance gating items. Diego, please do a quick resource estimate and recommended topology sketches. Connor, can you assess support and on-call implications for an on-prem pilot? Laura — happy to have you review before we send.

I've created a short internal checklist to capture inputs — attaching. If you can't hit the full note by tomorrow, please send a stub with the highest-risk items and a follow-up schedule.

Attachments: internal-prep-checklist.docx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation: VPC or on-prem deployment for regulated workloads

Vivek / team — quick security lens on what they'll need for either path. High-level:

VPC-hosted (private endpoints):
- Requirements: dedicated VPC peering or Private Service Connect; mutual TLS for control plane RPCs; KMS integration (bring-your-own) recommended.
- Evidence needed: SOC2 cert, data flow diagrams, list of logs we capture (audit, API tokens, admin actions).
- Gating items: if they require customer-controlled HSM, that's a nonstandard engineering effort (estimating ~3–4w to integrate and validate).

On-prem (air-gapped):
- Requirements: installer bundle, pre-shared images, offline license keys, strict egress controls, and an operations runbook.
- Evidence needed: signed attestation on imaging process, list of retained logs and retention controls.
- Gating items: we need a hardened deployment checklist; some features (auto-upgrade, cloud telemetry) will need explicit opt-outs.

Questions for Diego: do we have a compiled list of features that cannot operate in air-gapped mode? Also pinging Connor for an operations/incident handling note — on-call rotations will differ for on-prem pilots.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation: VPC or on-prem deployment for regulated workloads

Team — sketched two concrete options and a short resource estimate. Attaching spreadsheet with numbers, but summary below.

Option A — VPC private endpoint (recommended for speed):
- Pilot footprint (supports ~50 QPS, 8k-token models): 2x A100-equivalent nodes (NVIDIA A10/A100), 1x control-plane t3.large equivalent, 20TB EBS-equivalent storage for logs and models.
- Network: private link + NAT for controlled egress to KMS endpoint (BYO KMS).
- Timeline: 2–3 weeks (network setup + infra provisioning + smoke tests).
- Ops: Redwood-managed runtime with restricted connectivity; fast rollback via version pinning.
- Pros/Cons: faster, fewer changes to customer infra, limited by private link bandwidth.

Option B — On-prem air-gapped bundle (higher assurance):
- Pilot footprint (same perf target): 3x A100-equivalent nodes (on-prem GPUs often lower perf), 2x control-plane VMs for HA (on-customer), 25TB local storage (NFS), and one VM for log aggregation.
- Timeline: 6–10 weeks (image build, validations, air-gap validation, on-site support window).
- Nonstandard items: offline license keys, installation-runbook, restricted telemetry.
- Pros/Cons: highest control / compliance; higher lead time and higher support cost.

Estimated cost (pilot, 3 months):
- Option A (VPC): ~$120k–$165k (infrastructure + dedicated support retainer)
- Option B (On-prem): ~$210k–$320k (one-time setup + support + travel if needed)

Open risks / mitigation:
- KMS/HSM integration: adds 3–4w if customer requires an HSM.
- Model size/perf mismatch: we need sample prompt traces to validate token distribution — ask Acme for 48h of representative traces.
- Operational SLAs: recommend a 4w canary with automated fallback to hosted model.

Attachments: draft-resource-estimate.xlsx, vpc-onprem-risk-brief.pdf

Diego Fernandez
Engineering Lead, Runtime & Ops, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility: VPC / on-prem resourcing & risk triage

Vivek / team — thanks for the detailed options and the quick turnaround. The summary is helpful. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) We can start with Option A (VPC private endpoint) as a pilot to shorten time-to-value. Please include a short punchlist of network actions we need to complete (VPC subnet peering, firewall rules, expected IPs).

2) HSM: our security team prefers BYO-HSM for key custody. If that adds 3–4 weeks, we still want it — please include the integration cost in the estimate.

3) Pilot acceptance criteria: can you provide simple pass/fail checks (e.g., latency under 150ms p95, successful KMS operations, logs visible to our audit tool)?

We're happy to cover the pilot cost and engage procurement once we have the final figure. Can your team send a short pilot statement of work (SOW) and estimated invoice line items?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lindgren
Head of Cloud Platform, Acme Analytics
